my.title: My dashboard
my.purpose: Next expiries, assigned training, plan progress and notices.

my-profile.title: My profile
my-profile.purpose: Minimal profile: name, language, digit preference, contact and role. No photo.

my-settings.title: Settings and data rights
my-settings.purpose: Language and digits, calendar, notifications, and data requests (view, export, correction).

admin-access.title: Access
admin-access.purpose: Users, roles, scopes, partner organisations and access reviews; elevated grants need a second admin.

sign-in.title: Sign in
sign-in.purpose: Choose a demo role card. Opening a URL never signs anyone in.

signIn.title: Choose a demo role card
signIn.intro: Kafa'a has no passwords in the demo. Pick a role card to see the portal as that person; opening a link never signs anyone in.
signIn.localBody: All 57 personas are available. Data is synthetic and stays in this browser.
signIn.liveBody: Data is the live ENEC NEXUS demo record. Choosing a NEXUS role card signs you in to that card's NEXUS demo account; choosing a Kafa'a persona signs you in to that persona's shared Kafa'a demo account. Changes are saved and other visitors of the same card see them.

errors.kafaa_unavailable: Live sign-in for Kafa'a personas is not switched on for this site yet. Use local demo data to try this persona now.
errors.kafaa_not_resolved: The Kafa'a persona signed in, but the live Kafa'a records do not recognise it yet (a database update is pending). Use local demo data to try this persona now.
errors.kafaa_failed: Kafa'a persona sign-in failed. Try again in a moment, or use local demo data.
errors.nexus_unavailable: Choose this role card in ENEC NEXUS first (Sign in), then come back.

groups.staff: ENEC NEXUS role cards: managers and authorities

groupHelp.kafaa: Workforce roles Kafa'a adds for the demo (trainee, operator, instructor, licensing, HR, editor, admin, ECP). Each signs in to a shared Kafa'a demo account.
groupHelp.staff: The NEXUS role cards with elevated Kafa'a roles such as line manager, licensing coordinator or auditor.
groupHelp.staffBasic: NEXUS role cards that see Kafa'a as ordinary employees.
groupHelp.partners: Supplier, contractor and university users see only their own organisation.
groupHelp.public: Applicants see their own applications and practice quizzes.
groupHelp.oversight: Read-only roles: observers see released aggregate reports only.

my.intro: Your next expiries, assigned training, plan progress and notices in one place. Records shown here are mirrors of the systems of record.
my.noProfile: No Kafa'a profile for this role card
my.noProfileBody: This role card has no personal records in Kafa'a. Use the links in the menu to reach the areas your role opens.
my.flagOnly: date and flag only, no medical content

profile.intro: The minimal profile Kafa'a keeps about you. You can change your language and digits; other details come from systems of record and are corrected through a request.
profile.noRowBody: Personal settings need a Kafa'a profile. This role card has none.
profile.synthetic: Synthetic demo person. No real staff data is held in this demo.
profile.moreSettings: Calendar, theme, notifications and data rights are in
profile.nexusRoles: Your Kafa'a roles are mapped from your ENEC NEXUS role card. Kafa'a never changes NEXUS roles.
profile.keep1: Name, organisation, job role and team, to show the right content.
profile.keep2: Mirrors of qualification, licence and training records, read-only.
profile.not1: Photos, Emirates ID or passport numbers.
profile.not2: Medical details (only a due date and a fit flag for licensed operators).
profile.not3: Concern reports (those stay with the Employee Concerns Program).
profile.correctBody: If something here is wrong, send a correction request. The owner of the source record fixes it there and the mirror updates.
profile.correctHint: Do not include sensitive personal data.

settings.intro: Display preferences apply immediately. Consents can be withdrawn at any time, and you can ask to view, export, correct or delete your data.
settings.inappHint: Expiries, assignments and application updates in Kafa'a.
settings.emailHint: Demo only: no email is sent.
settings.mandatory: Licence and qualification expiry notices are always shown in the app.
settings.noConsents: You have not given any consents.
settings.withdrawBody: Kafa'a stops using this data for the stated purpose. An application that depends on this consent can no longer progress.
settings.rightsBody: Ask to view, export, correct or delete the data Kafa'a holds about you. Records mirrored from a system of record are corrected at the source.
settings.exportScope: The download covers your own rows in {n} tables, read with your own permissions.
settings.exportNote: Self-service export from Kafa'a demo. Mirrored records belong to their source systems.
settings.sla: The data protection team responds within 30 days (demo rule).
settings.deletionNote: Records the law or a licence requires us to keep (for example licence history) cannot be deleted; you will be told which.
settings.retention: Kafa'a keeps Dalil logs for 30 days, unsuccessful applications until the published deletion date and contact requests for 180 days.

access.intro: Grant, approve, review and revoke Kafa'a roles. Elevated grants need a second admin. Partner admins manage their own organisation's partner users.
access.readOnly: You can see users, roles and reviews but cannot change them.
access.partnerScope: You see and manage people in {org} only, and can grant the partner user role.
access.name: Name
access.noPending: No grants are waiting for a second admin.
access.makerChecker: You made this grant (or it is for you), so another admin must approve it.
access.reviewIntro: Elevated grants are reviewed every {n} days. Keep confirms the person still needs the role; revoke removes it. You cannot review your own access.
access.leaverIntro: A leaver's roles stop working at once: Kafa'a ignores assignments for people marked as leavers. Revoke them here to keep the record clean.
access.leaverPerson: This person has left. Their roles no longer grant access.
access.scopeHint: For example a team, crew or organisation id
access.elevatedNote: Elevated role: it stays pending until a second admin approves.
access.revokeBody: The person loses this access immediately. The reason is recorded in the audit log.
access.keepBody: Confirms the person still needs this access. The next review falls due in 92 days.
access.reviewSelf: Recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS evidence ledger.
access.matrixIntro: What each Kafa'a role can do on each resource. The same matrix drives page guards, the repository and database row-level security.
access.matrixFoot: {n} resources. A dot means no access (deny by default).
